cases.description: Add release notes to the changelog.
cases.prompt:
In CHANGELOG.md, add a new release section for version 0.3.2 dated 2026-01-24 ABOVE the 0.3.1 section. Use exactly this block (including blank lines):

## [0.3.2] - 2026-01-24
### Added
- Added retries to sync command.

### Fixed
- Fixed log prefix for errors.

Return ONLY JSON.

files.expect_text:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [0.3.2] - 2026-01-24
### Added
- Added retries to sync command.

### Fixed
- Fixed log prefix for errors.

## [0.3.1] - 2026-01-10
### Added
- Initial sync command.

### Fixed
- Crash when config missing.

cases.description: Add a dry-run CLI flag and docs.
cases.prompt: Add support for a --dry-run flag in src/cli.ts. It should set options.dryRun to true (default false). Update the usage text to mention the flag and add a dry-run example in README.md. Keep existing style. Return ONLY JSON.

cases.description: Upgrade CI Node version and enable npm cache.
cases.prompt: Update .github/workflows/ci.yml to use Node 20 and enable npm cache in the setup-node step. Keep formatting. Return ONLY JSON.
